cells.action: Per D1-D5 (store 906e0b1f, 63bd6725, f84f697c, 8ea1fa19). (1) devtools/hook_manifests.rs: in the PreToolUse event add a CLAUDE_ONLY group, matcher `Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash|Monitor|EnterWorktree|ExitWorktree|mcp__.*`, script `bee-worker-guard.mjs` (the name-to-verb mapping strips `bee-` and `.mjs`, giving `hook worker-guard`), with no status message, beside the shared write-guard group at `Some("Edit|Write|MultiEdit|Bash|Read|Glob|Grep|AskUserQuestion|apply_patch|exec")`. (2) onboard/hooks_wiring.rs: add the same entry with the same matcher to its Claude PreToolUse table beside `{ "matcher": "Agent|Task", "hooks": [repo_entry("bee-model-guard.mjs", r)] }`. (3) Run `bee dev render-hook-manifests` (claude-hooks.json gains the group; hooks.json for Codex must not change) and `bee onboard --repo-root . --apply` so this repo's .claude/settings.json carries the entry; commit only the files listed. (4) hooks/worker_guard.rs, read-only path only: judge `Monitor` by its `command` input exactly as Bash; deny `EnterWorktree`, `ExitWorktree` and any tool name starting `mcp__` by name with the read-only denial text; add `cd` to READ_ONLY_ALLOWED. Mode A and mode B results for other inputs do not change. (5) herding/run.rs `execute_paseo`: replace the pi-only gate `if opts.read_only && !provider_is_pi {` with pi-or-claude; other providers refuse with a FIX line naming pi and claude. For claude + read_only, before spawn: run `<main root>/.bee/bin/bee hook --help` and require `worker-guard` in its output, and read `<main root>/.claude/settings.json` and require a PreToolUse hook command containing `hook worker-guard`; on either miss refuse with a FIX line (`bee onboard --apply` / refresh .bee/bin/bee). Keep `--mode` as configured. Tests: manifest test that the Claude projection has the group (matcher, script, no status message) and Codex has none; onboard table test for the entry; guard rows for Monitor (allowed rg, denied redirect), EnterWorktree, an mcp__ write tool, `cd x && rg y` allowed, and mode A denying `git push` for a claude Paseo worker payload; run.rs rows: claude read-only spawns with BEE_HERDING_READ_ONLY=1 and the configured mode when both checks pass, refuses when the binary help lacks worker-guard, refuses when settings lack the entry, and codex still refuses naming pi and claude.
